units.rawText: Pardon me, I ought to be dressed. I hope my scars haven't put you off.
units.displayText: Pardon me, I ought to be dressed. I hope my scars haven't put you off.

spans.text: Pardon me, I ought to be dressed. I hope my scars haven't put you off.

units.rawText: Someone once reminded me to get my scars taken care of. But you see, each scar represents a sweet memory for me, so it's hard to let them go.
units.displayText: Someone once reminded me to get my scars taken care of. But you see, each scar represents a sweet memory for me, so it's hard to let them go.

spans.text: Someone once reminded me to get my scars taken care of. But you see, each scar represents a sweet memory for me, so it's hard to let them go.

units.rawText: For instance, this one here. I got it when one of the test subjects I was chasing sprang a trap on me and shoved my arm into a rotary saw. Ah, the pain is still fresh in my mind.

units.rawText: And the ones here, by my ribs, those were from when one of the test subjects shanked me a few times.

units.rawText: Still, there's no need to worry, those poor lost lambs got their just desserts. Would you like to see their scapulae, Professor? They're very pretty.
